messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging — embeddings-service error rate >5% (us-west-2). Alert rule: `5xx_rate` over 5m. Pager: oncall-eng-night.

Alice M: on it, I saw a spike. taking lead for now. can someone grab logs for the last 15m?

Ben R: grabbing logs, also noticed a config push ~09:12 UTC to scaling-agent. tagging @Carla S who did the change.

Carla S: that was a small tweak to KV cache eviction TTL (lowered from 10m -> 2m) to free mem on a big batch job. reverting now.

Carla S: rollback command I ran:
```
kubectl -n inference rollout undo deploy/embeddings-service --to-revision=56
```

Dinesh K: logs (truncated):
```
[09:14:21] embeddings-service ERROR: kvcache miss flood, inflight requests > 2000, backend timeout
[09:14:22] upstream grpc: deadline exceeded
```

Alice M: good, thanks. Carla — can you confirm rollout completed and pods are steady?

Carla S: rollout finished at 09:19 UTC. pods READY 6/6. health checks green.

Ben R: metrics trending back down. 5xx now ~0.8% in 5m. :white_check_mark:

Incident-bot: Incident update: severity -> SEV2 (degraded service), affected customers: subset of high-throughput embedding callers in us-west-2.

Frank T: customer impact note — two enterprise customers (acct: AcmeCorp, NeuralSoft) reported elevated latencies and retry storms. support ticket links: <https://redwood.atlassian.net/si/ACME-987>, <https://redwood.atlassian.net/si/NS-412>. we should include this in postmortem.

Alice M: agreed. action items: 1) timeline + RCA draft, 2) update runbook for KV cache changes, 3) create regression test for eviction TTL changes, 4) customer comms summary. assigning owners below.

Eva L: I can draft the RCA writeup. target first draft EOD today. need timeline artifacts: env change diff, deploy logs, metrics graphs. can folks drop links here?

Dinesh K: pushed logs to ephemeral S3: s3://redwood-incident-logs/1845267890/ — includes kube events, service logs, and the deploy manifest diff.

Carla S: deploy manifest diff (snippet):
```
- name: KV_EVICTION_TTL
- value: "600"
+ value: "120"
```

Ben R: I'll open a tracking ticket and link the RCA: <https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-2468>. Setting labels: incident, embeddings, postmortem-needed. ETA for backlog ticket to be linked to postmortem doc: 1h.

Frank T: I'll draft the customer comms summary after the RCA draft — will coordinate with Support.

Alice M: handoff — I'm leaving in 20m and handing to night oncall Dinesh K. Dinesh, please own incident until postmortem kickoff and keep this thread for updates.

Dinesh K: ack. I'll keep watch, escalate if anything pops. Posting a short timeline so Eva has a starting point.

Eva L: thanks. I'll prepare a draft and ping for review from Ben/Carla/Alice. prefer peer review before sign-off. target sign-off by tomorrow 17:00 UTC.

Ben R: can we have action items with owners in the ticket? quick list: INF-2468:
- write RCA draft (Eva L)
- verify regression tests (Ben R)
- update runbook + add TTL guardrail (Carla S)
- customer comms (Frank T)
- follow-up postmortem meeting (Alice M)

Alice M: yes. also add a note: consider adding alert that flags sudden drop in KV hit ratio when eviction TTL < 5m.

incident-bot: Reminder: schedule postmortem meeting within 72 hours. Use template: <https://redwood.sheets/postmortem-template>.

Frank T: re: comms — I'll coordinate with support and legal for any contract-impact language.

Dinesh K: leaving it in watch mode. ping me here if you need logs/queries.

Alice M: thanks all. nice quick rollback. let's make sure the RCA covers the human and system factors (guardrails, deploy review, rollbacks). :eyes:

Eva L: I'll post the draft here when ready.

Ben R: thx — remind me to pull the exact traffic graphs for the impact window.

Carla S: adding small follow-up: I'll add a pre-deploy CI check to fail changes that lower eviction TTL below 5m unless approved.

Alice M: closing the immediate mitigation. keeping thread open for RCA draft + sign-off updates. :white_check_mark:
